public_rationale: Anthropic publicly released and promoted Claude computer use on October 22, 2024. Its developer beta preceded Google's December 2024 Project Mariner prototype announcement and OpenAI's January 2025 Operator preview. That record supports the ordinary meaning of being among the early leading promoters. Adept demonstrated related capabilities in 2022, so the evidence would not support a stronger claim that Anthropic invented computer-control AI or was first across every category.
limitations: Forefront is a qualitative description, not a measured market-share or performance ranking.
The comparison covers relevant public announcements, not every private research effort.
The evidence does not establish responsibility for the agent failures described elsewhere in the post.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Anthropic was at the forefront of pushing agentic computer-control AI.

statement.excerpt: Before you say this has nothing to do with Anthropic, just remember this: Anthropic was at the forefront pushing this kind of agentic-control-your-computer AI.
statement.document_title: There are no heroes in commercial AI

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that Anthropic was an early, prominent developer and promoter of AI that carries out tasks by operating computer interfaces.
At the forefront means among the leading participants; it does not assert sole invention, absolute chronological priority, or consistently superior performance.
Pushing is assessed through public release, developer availability, demonstrations, and promotion.
The retrospective wording describes activity before the March 8, 2026 post. No starting date is supplied, so the target period has an open start.
The surrounding anecdotes do not make this sentence a claim that Anthropic caused every cited incident.
criteria.support_condition: Dated records establish that Anthropic publicly promoted and made general computer-control capabilities available during the early commercial development of this category, with a release chronology consistent with a leading role.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated records establish that Anthropic entered only after the category was well established and played no early or prominent role in developing or promoting it.

evidence.locator: Opening section, paragraph introducing computer use
evidence.explanation: The dated announcement releases computer use to developers and actively promotes its applications. It describes screen reading, cursor movement, clicking, and typing; its priority language is a company claim, while the release itself directly establishes early public participation.

OpenAI introduced Operator as a research preview after Anthropic's October 2024 release. This is a relevant browser-control comparison, although it does not establish the date of every earlier OpenAI experiment.

evidence.locator: Project Mariner: agents that can help you accomplish complex tasks
evidence.explanation: Google announced its browser-control prototype and trusted testing after Anthropic's public beta. This supports the comparative chronology without treating browser control as identical to unrestricted desktop control.

evidence.locator: Paragraph describing Salesforce and other demonstrations
evidence.explanation: Adept demonstrated related interface-control capabilities roughly two years earlier. This rules out reading Marcus as claiming Anthropic invented the category; reporting is used because Adept's primary announcement could not be accessed.
